title: Reranking, SciFact (50 candidates per query)
decision: how well a retrieved passage supplies what a query asks for; the candidates of a query are ranked by the answer

source.name: system1-rerank-bench (BEIR SciFact and NFCorpus test queries with hybrid-search candidates)

licence: candidate lists: MIT (system1-rerank-bench); SciFact texts and judgments: CC BY-NC 2.0 (as listed by BEIR)
notes: All 100 queries with all their candidates (the row cap does not apply to ranking tasks). Graded judgments of the candidates: {0: 4889, 1: 111}; 111 of the 115 judged-relevant documents are among the candidates, so a perfect reranker stays below 1. `gold` is only the placeholder the format requires (3 = highest grade of the set, 2 = a lower positive grade, 0 = not judged relevant); the metric uses meta.relevance and meta.ideal_gains. The rubric wording is the one registered in the source test for decision models, one passage per request. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 1100 of 5000 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 3900 items remain.
